# Australian benefits Silver and Gold

Conductor track:
`conductor/tracks/australian_benefits_silver_gold_20260829/`

Implement typed, source-faithful MBS and PBS Silver tables and a reviewable,
temporal Gold evidence graph. Preserve every legacy/current schema era and
source-native identifier; keep MBS service benefits, PBS funding, ARTG
regulatory evidence, AMT terminology, and ATC classification independent.

Gold edges require method, confidence, source evidence, time, rights, review,
and negative controls. Candidate links never imply therapeutic equivalence,
clinical appropriateness, funding, approval, or patient eligibility.

Requirements: M-106, M-107, M-109, M-110, M-112, S-014, C-014, W-011.
